thread:
ella_support: FYI — getting multiple tickets about the Metering/Cost dashboard showing $0 or NaN for some orgs since ~2026-03-16 22:00 UTC. Examples: org_9812, org_4401. CSV export also has NaN. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/metering?range=24h&panel=token-costs :eyes:

jess_product: Which tickets / any pattern (region, plan, dedicated vs hosted)? CSV having NaN suggests backend join issue not just UI render.

ella_support: Tickets #T-4217 and #T-4219. Both hosted and Dedicated orgs affected, mostly EU region but not exclusively.

mike_billing: quick check on ledger — found rows with NULL model_price for recent usage_events. suspect join to pricing table returned no match for some model ids. sample:
```sql
SELECT org_id, model_id, SUM(tokens) as tok, AVG(model_price) as price
FROM usage_events LEFT JOIN model_pricing USING (model_id)
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-16'
GROUP BY 1,2
HAVING AVG(model_price) IS NULL;
```
results: org_9812 / model gptx-8e-quant -> price NULL

devon_sre: @mike_billing good catch. We had a pricing ingest job failure overnight (billing-ingest). ingest-bot shows a nonzero exit at 2026-03-16T21:45Z.

ingest_bot: billing-ingest: failed at 2026-03-16T21:45:12Z exit=1 stderr="unique constraint violation on price_updates (model_id,version)". Retry disabled.

mike_billing: sounds like the model_pricing table missing some rows because the ingest never completed. Two options: re-run ingest to restore full table, then backfill costs; or run a controlled backfill that fills missing prices with a fallback and then re-run ingest to correct prices later.

jess_product: any customer-facing mitigation we can ask support to provide?

ella_support: For impacted customers I can send a note: "We're aware of a dashboard rendering gap causing $0/NaN rows; engineering is running a backfill. Costs are still being recorded in the ledger and will be visible soon." Need ETA.

mike_billing: Starting a backfill pass now for orgs with NULL prices. Backfill plan: (1) re-run billing-ingest in read-only mode to load pricing table where possible, (2) run SQL backfill to populate token_costs for rows with NULL price, using last-known price or temporary fallback of 0.00005 USD/token. Running in 1-hour batches to limit load. SQL snippet for step (2):
```sql
WITH missing AS (
  SELECT id FROM token_costs WHERE model_price IS NULL LIMIT 100000
)
UPDATE token_costs tc
SET model_price = COALESCE((SELECT price FROM model_pricing mp WHERE mp.model_id = tc.model_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1), 0.00005)
WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM missing);
```
Kickoff job id=bf-20260317-01.

devon_sre: recommend re-running billing-ingest with --skip-duplicates off and set a short window to avoid reprocessing huge backlog. Also open PR to make ingest idempotent for duplicates.

mike_billing: started bf-20260317-01 at 2026-03-17T01:10Z. Estimated 90m to complete full backfill for current window. Will post progress.

ella_support: ETA + messaging noted. I'll update both tickets and post a short status on #statuspage.

console_bot: dashboard refresh queued for affected panels, refresh window ~5-10m after backfill batches complete.

mike_billing: update: 40% through first pass (org_9812 & 4401 are included). CSV export will show corrected values as rows complete.

jess_product: thanks team. Can someone follow up to confirm root cause (ingest failure reason) and add to postmortem?

devon_sre: opened incident draft and assigned action items: make billing-ingest retryable on constraint errors, add alert for price_join_null_rate > 0.1%, and schedule a postmortem.

ella_support: customers updated. Marking this escalation as "in progress" until backfill done.

mike_billing: backfill job id=bf-20260317-01 final update at 2026-03-17T02:12Z: job completed for current window; dashboards should reflect non-NaN prices within ~10m. I'll watch for any remaining orgs.

ella_support: closing escalation if no new reports after 30m. :thumbsup:
